def top_share(M):            # share of squared Frobenius norm in the top singular direction (rows = units)
    s = np.linalg.svd(M, compute_uv=False); return (s[0]**2/np.sum(s**2))
dirs_g, dirs_d = {}, {}

    Wg = load_original(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.gate_proj.weight').numpy()
    Wu = load_original(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.up_proj.weight').numpy()
    Wd = load_original(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight').numpy()
    _,_,Vt = np.linalg.svd(Wu, full_matrices=False); v0=Vt[0]
    grp = E2rows[L]; s = np.sign(Wu[grp]@v0)
    G = Wg[grp]; Dc = Wd[:, grp].T                     # n x 1152 each
    rnd = [np.setdiff1d(rng.choice(6912, len(grp), replace=False), grp) for _ in range(30)]
    tg = top_share(G); tg_r = np.mean([top_share(Wg[r]) for r in rnd])
    td = top_share(Dc); td_r = np.mean([top_share(Wd[:, r].T) for r in rnd])
    # signed coherence of down columns: |sum s_i d_i| vs sqrt(sum |d_i|^2)

    best, arg = S.max(dim=1)
    better = (best > own + 0.2) & (best > 0.4)

    recip = [int(i) for i in idx if better[arg[i]] and int(arg[arg[i]]) == int(i)]
    out.append(f"L{L:2d} own score median {own.median():.2f} | n(best foreign > own+.2 & >.4) {int(better.sum())} | reciprocal pairs {len(recip)//2}")
    if recip: found.append((L, recip[:10]))

import numpy as np, torch
out = []
for L in range(26):
    D = load_original(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight').float().T
    G = load_original(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.gate_proj.weight').float()
    U = load_original(f'model.layers.{L}.mlp.up_proj.weight').float()
    nz = lambda X: X / X.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    Gn, Un, Dn = nz(G), nz(U), nz(D)
    CU = Un @ Un.T; CG = Gn @ Gn.T
    mask = (CU > 0.5) & (CG > 0.3); mask.fill_diagonal_(False)
    ii, jj = torch.nonzero(torch.triu(mask, 1), as_tuple=True)
    cd = (Dn[ii] * Dn[jj]).sum(1).numpy() if len(ii) else np.array([])
    # also pairs with similar gate but OPPOSITE up (cos(up) < -0.5) -> natural if down agrees in sign*...
    mask2 = (CU < -0.5) & (CG > 0.3); mask2.fill_diagonal_(False)
    i2, j2 = torch.nonzero(torch.triu(mask2, 1), as_tuple=True)
    cd2 = (Dn[i2] * Dn[j2]).sum(1).numpy() if len(i2) else np.array([])
    out.append(f"L{L:2d} similar-input pairs {len(cd):4d}: down agree {int((cd>0.3).sum()):4d} oppose {int((cd<-0.3).sum()):3d} | gate-sim & up-opposite pairs {len(cd2):3d}: down agree {int((cd2>0.3).sum())} oppose {int((cd2<-0.3).sum())}")

    Gn, Un, Dn = nz(G), nz(U), nz(D)
    CU = Un @ Un.T; CG = Gn @ Gn.T
    for sgn, mask in [(+1, (CU > 0.5) & (CG > 0.3)), (-1, (CU < -0.5) & (CG > 0.3))]:
        mask.fill_diagonal_(False)
